Markdown Content:

# NIHONGO LESSONS

A new app for people serious about becoming fluent in Japanese.

[](https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1640204242)

## THE NEW HOME OF JALUP

The end of Jalup? Don't think so.  
  
Nihongo Lessons takes the excellent Japanese Level Up (Jalup) series, gives it a fresh coat of paint and tons of new features.

## BEGINNER TO FLUENT

Nihongo Lessons is structured as a step-by-step guide that will lead you from absolute beginner all the way to fluency.

## NO MORE TEXTBOOK

Everything in Nihongo Lessons is in flashcard format, rather than a traditional textbook.  
  
Flashcards are easier to take in, easier to know how much to learn and how often to review, and simplify the mountain of information you need to absorb.

## SENTENCE-BASED LEARNING

Each flashcard introduces one new sentence for you to understand, even from the very first card.
